editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FBS is a legit, CySEC and ASIC-regulated broker that has operated since 2009 and built a client base of 27 million accounts — primarily across Southeast Asia and Africa. The $5 minimum deposit and CySEC entity make it technically accessible and technically regulated in 2026. But the majority of global clients land on the FSC Belize offshore entity with 1:3000 leverage, minimal oversight, and zero investor compensation. Four country-level regulators (Malaysia, Brazil, Ukraine) have issued warnings about FBS operating without proper local authorisation — not enough to call it a scam, but enough to call it a pattern. The 68.53% retail loss rate is actually lower than many competitors, and withdrawal processing within 24 hours is respectable. FBS is not fraudulent. But it is a broker that has built its empire by offering maximum risk to the traders who can least afford it, in the jurisdictions with the least protection. Approach with open eyes and use only money you can genuinely afford to lose.
